description.en: Enables or disables a numbered match visual effect flag (a bit in the current match state's effect bitmask). Effect 0 additionally flips a dedicated flag on the match result data.
Non-zero to enable the effect, 0 to disable it.
Index of the effect bit to toggle (bit 0 also updates the match result's own flag).
True once the effect flag has been updated; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
